# BASIC NUMERIC CLEANING

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    survival_months = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(survival_months)),
    time_from_diagnosis_to_treatment_in_days_recode =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(time_from_diagnosis_to_treatment_in_days_recode)),
    year_of_diagnosis = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year_of_diagnosis)),
    tumor_size_summary_2016 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tumor_size_summary_2016)),
    regional_nodes_examined_1988 =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(regional_nodes_examined_1988)),
    regional_nodes_positive_1988 =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(regional_nodes_positive_1988))
  )

# Clean missing
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # survival_months: 9999 means unknown
    survival_months = ifelse(survival_months >= 9999, NA, survival_months),

    # time_to_treatment: 999 means unknown
    time_from_diagnosis_to_treatment_in_days_recode =
      na_if(time_from_diagnosis_to_treatment_in_days_recode, 999),

    # tumor_size_summary_2016 often uses 999 as unknown
    tumor_size_summary_2016 = na_if(tumor_size_summary_2016, 999),

    # nodes often use 99 as unknown
    regional_nodes_examined_1988 = na_if(regional_nodes_examined_1988, 99),
    regional_nodes_positive_1988 = na_if(regional_nodes_positive_1988, 99)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        race_recode_white_black_other,
        radiation_recode,
        rx_summ_surg_rad_seq,
        rx_summ_systemic_sur_seq_2007,
        reason_no_cancer_directed_surgery,
        diagnostic_confirmation,
        combined_summary_stage_with_expanded_regional_codes_2004,
        grade_clinical_2018,
        grade_pathological_2018,
        marital_status_at_diagnosis
      ),
      ~ na_if(., 9)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        brain_molecular_markers_2018,
        median_household_income_inflation_adj_to_2023,
        rural_urban_continuum_code
      ),
      ~ na_if(., 99)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    brain_molecular_markers_2018 = na_if(brain_molecular_markers_2018, 126)
  )

# Check with survival flag 
# SURVIVAL OUTCOME VARIABLES
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    time = survival_months,
    event = case_when(
      vital_status_recode_study_cutoff_used == 1 ~ 1,
      vital_status_recode_study_cutoff_used == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# AGE FACTOR
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    age_factor = factor(
      age_recode_with_1_year_olds_and_90,
      levels = 0:19,
      ordered = TRUE
    ) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "00 years" = "0",
        "01-04 years" = "1",
        "05-09 years" = "2",
        "10-14 years" = "3",
        "15-19 years" = "4",
        "20-24 years" = "5",
        "25-29 years" = "6",
        "30-34 years" = "7",
        "35-39 years" = "8",
        "40-44 years" = "9",
        "45-49 years" = "10",
        "50-54 years" = "11",
        "55-59 years" = "12",
        "60-64 years" = "13",
        "65-69 years" = "14",
        "70-74 years" = "15",
        "75-79 years" = "16",
        "80-84 years" = "17",
        "85-89 years" = "18",
        "90+ years" = "19"
      )
  )

# Drop below 18
# DEMOGRAPHIC FACTORS
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    race_factor = factor(race_recode_white_black_other) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "White" = "1",
        "Black" = "2",
        "Other" = "3"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    sex_factor = factor(sex) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Male" = "1",
        "Female" = "2"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    marital_status_factor = factor(marital_status_at_diagnosis) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Single" = "1",
        "Married" = "2",
        "Separated" = "3",
        "Divorced" = "4",
        "Widowed" = "5",
        "Unmarried or Domestic Partner" = "6"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown")
  )


# TREATMENT FACTORS

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    radiation_factor = factor(radiation_recode) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "None" = "0",
        "Beam Radiation" = "1",
        "Radioactive Implants" = "2",
        "Radioisotopes" = "5",
        "Refused" = "7",
        "Recommended, Unknown if Given" = "8"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    radiation_binary = case_when(
      radiation_recode == 1 ~ "Yes",
      radiation_recode %in% c(0, 2, 5, 7, 8) ~ "No/Other",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    radiation_binary = factor(radiation_binary,
                              levels = c("No/Other", "Yes", "Unknown")),

    chemo_factor = factor(chemotherapy_recode_yes_no_unk) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "No/Unknown" = "0",
        "Yes" = "1"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    surgery_performed = case_when(
      reason_no_cancer_directed_surgery == 0 ~ "Surgery Performed",
      reason_no_cancer_directed_surgery %in% c(1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "No Surgery",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    surgery_performed = factor(
      surgery_performed,
      levels = c("Surgery Performed", "No Surgery", "Unknown")
    ),

    surgery_sequence_factor = factor(rx_summ_surg_rad_seq) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "No Radiation and/or No Surgery" = "0",
        "Radiation Before Surgery" = "2",
        "Radiation After Surgery" = "3",
        "Intraoperative Radiation" = "4",
        "Intraoperative + Other Radiation" = "5",
        "Surgery Both Before and After Radiation" = "6"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    systemic_sequence_factor = factor(rx_summ_systemic_sur_seq_2007) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "No Systemic Therapy and/or No Surgery" = "0",
        "Systemic Therapy Before Surgery" = "2",
        "Systemic Therapy After Surgery" = "3",
        "Systemic Therapy Both Before and After Surgery" = "4"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown")
  )


# TUMOR / DISEASE FACTORS

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    stage_factor = factor(combined_summary_stage_with_expanded_regional_codes_2004) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Localized" = "1",
        "Regional" = "2",
        "Distant" = "7",
        "Benign" = "8"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    diagnostic_confirmation_factor = factor(diagnostic_confirmation) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Positive Histology" = "1",
        "Positive Cytology" = "2",
        "Positive Laboratory Test/Marker Study" = "4",
        "Direct Visualization without Microscopic Confirmation" = "5",
        "Radiography without Microscopic Confirmation" = "6",
        "Clinical Diagnosis Only" = "7",
        "Unknown" = "8"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    histology_factor = factor(histology_recode_broad_groupings) %>%
      fct_collapse(
        "Glioma" = c("35"),
        "Germ Cell Neoplasm" = c("25"),
        "Neuroepitheliomatous Neoplasm" = c("36"),
        "Fibromatous Neoplasm" = c("17"),
        "Other Malignant" = c("0", "2", "15", "16", "20", "21", "28", "30", "32", "34", "38")
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    primary_site_factor = factor(primary_site_labeled) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Cerebrum NOS" = "710",
        "Frontal Lobe" = "711",
        "Temporal Lobe" = "712",
        "Parietal Lobe" = "713",
        "Occipital Lobe" = "714",
        "Ventricle" = "715",
        "Cerebellum" = "716",
        "Brain Stem" = "717",
        "Overlapping Lesion of Brain" = "718",
        "Brain NOS" = "719"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown")
  )


# GRADE
# Use pathological first, clinical if path missing

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    grade_combined_raw = coalesce(grade_pathological_2018, grade_clinical_2018),

    grade_factor = factor(grade_combined_raw) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Grade I" = "1",
        "Grade II" = "2",
        "Grade III" = "3",
        "Grade IV" = "4",
        "Cell Type Not Determined, Not Stated or Not Applicable" = "9"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    grade_binary = case_when(
      grade_combined_raw %in% c(1, 2, 15) ~ "Low Grade",
      grade_combined_raw %in% c(3, 4, 16) ~ "High Grade",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    grade_binary = factor(grade_binary,
                          levels = c("Low Grade", "High Grade", "Unknown"))
  )

# MOLECULAR MARKERS

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    molecular_factor = factor(brain_molecular_markers_2018) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, Grade II" = "1",
        "Astrocytoma, IDH-wildtype, Grade II" = "2",
        "Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, Grade III" = "3",
        "Astrocytoma, IDH-wildtype, Grade III" = "4",
        "Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype" = "5",
        "Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted" = "6",
        "Oligodendroglioma, Grade III, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted" = "7",
        "Medulloblastoma / Other" = "8",
        "Embryonal / Other" = "9",
        "Not Applicable" = "85",
        "Test Ordered, Results Not in Chart" = "87"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    molecular_collapsed = case_when(
      brain_molecular_markers_2018 %in% c(1, 3) ~ "Astrocytoma IDH-mutant",
      brain_molecular_markers_2018 %in% c(2, 4, 5) ~ "IDH-wildtype",
      brain_molecular_markers_2018 %in% c(6, 7) ~ "Oligodendroglioma IDH-mutant 1p19q-codeleted",
      brain_molecular_markers_2018 %in% c(8, 9) ~ "Other Molecular Group",
      brain_molecular_markers_2018 %in% c(85, 87) ~ "Not Applicable/Pending",
      is.na(brain_molecular_markers_2018) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    molecular_collapsed = factor(
      molecular_collapsed,
      levels = c(
        "Astrocytoma IDH-mutant",
        "IDH-wildtype",
        "Oligodendroglioma IDH-mutant 1p19q-codeleted",
        "Other Molecular Group",
        "Not Applicable/Pending",
        "Unknown"
      )
    )
  )


# SOCIOECONOMIC GEOGRAPHIC VARIABLES

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    income_factor = factor(median_household_income_inflation_adj_to_2023) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "<$35,000" = "1",
        "$35,000-$39,999" = "2",
        "$40,000-$44,999" = "3",
        "$45,000-$49,999" = "4",
        "$50,000-$54,999" = "5",
        "$55,000-$59,999" = "6",
        "$60,000-$64,999" = "7",
        "$65,000-$69,999" = "8",
        "$70,000-$74,999" = "9",
        "$75,000+" = "10"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    income_binary = case_when(
      median_household_income_inflation_adj_to_2023 %in% 1:9 ~ "<$75,000",
      median_household_income_inflation_adj_to_2023 == 10 ~ "$75,000+",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    income_binary = factor(income_binary,
                           levels = c("<$75,000", "$75,000+", "Unknown")),

    rurality_factor = factor(rural_urban_continuum_code) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Metro 1M+" = "1",
        "Metro 250K-1M" = "2",
        "Metro <250K" = "3",
        "Urban Adjacent" = "4",
        "Urban Nonadjacent" = "5",
        "Rural Adjacent" = "6",
        "Rural Nonadjacent" = "7",
        "Completely Rural or <2,500 Urban Population, Adjacent" = "8",
        "Completely Rural or <2,500 Urban Population, Nonadjacent" = "9"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    rurality_binary = case_when(
      rural_urban_continuum_code %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ "Metropolitan",
      rural_urban_continuum_code %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) ~ "Non-metropolitan",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    rurality_binary = factor(rurality_binary,
                             levels = c("Metropolitan", "Non-metropolitan", "Unknown"))
  )

## 5180 3779
df_ml <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(stage_binary = ifelse(stage_factor == "Localized", "Localized", "Advanced"),
         stage_binary = factor(stage_binary))

df_ml <- df_ml %>%
  filter(!molecular_collapsed %in% c("Unknown", "Not Applicable/Pending")) %>%
  droplevels()

df_ml <- df_ml %>%
  filter(!is.na(time))

df_ml <- df_ml %>%
  mutate(
    sex_factor = factor(sex_factor),
    race_factor = factor(race_factor),
    stage_factor = factor(stage_factor),
    radiation_binary = factor(radiation_binary),
    chemo_factor = factor(chemo_factor),
    surgery_performed = factor(surgery_performed),
    income_binary = factor(income_binary),
    rurality_binary = factor(rurality_binary)
  )

## create binary outcome for machine learning
df_ml <- df_ml %>%

# create high-risk outcome
df_ml <- df_ml %>%
  mutate(high_risk = ifelse(time < 12, "HighRisk", "LowRisk"),
         high_risk = factor(high_risk, levels = c("HighRisk", "LowRisk")))

Create the split and CV

# Data partition
set.seed(2)

data_split <- initial_split(df_model, prop = 0.8, strata = high_risk)

training_data <- training(data_split)
testing_data  <- testing(data_split)

# set up cross validation
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10,
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                     classProbs = TRUE)

Elastic Net

set.seed(2)

en.grid <- expand.grid(
  alpha = seq(0, 1, length = 11),
  lambda = exp(seq(-8, 1, length = 100))
)

en.fit <- train(
  high_risk ~ .,
  data = training_data,
  method = "glmnet",
  tuneGrid = en.grid,
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric = "ROC"
)

ggplot(en.fit, highlight = TRUE)
## Warning: `aes_string()` was deprecated in ggplot2 3.0.0.

en.fit$bestTune
##     alpha   lambda
## 100     0 2.718282
# predicted probabilities
en.prob <- predict(en.fit, newdata = testing_data, type = "prob")[, "HighRisk"]

# predicted classes
en.pred <- predict(en.fit, newdata = testing_data)

# confusion matrix
confusionMatrix(en.pred, testing_data$high_risk)

# test misclassification error
mean(en.pred != testing_data$high_risk)
## [1] 0.4098222
# test AUC
roc.en <- roc(testing_data$high_risk, en.prob)
## Setting levels: control = HighRisk, case = LowRisk
## Setting direction: controls > cases
roc.en$auc
## Area under the curve: 0.775
plot(roc.en, legacy.axes = TRUE)
